description:
About Lundin Software

  • Software company with Headquarters in Bucharest since 2006
  • Main product is Gannet - aircraft maintenance information software 
  • Customers in 20 countries on 5 continents

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop a strong understanding of the Gannet system and contribute to its continuous improvement
  • Handle and resolve customer support tickets in a timely and effective manner  
  • Take ownership of issues, working closely with customers to ensure their expectations are met
  • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions, contributing to product enhancements
  • Minimize escalations by reproducing issues and improving processes and support tools

 

Desired Skills

  • Experience with supporting ERP Applications and their corresponding business processes
  • Experience working with Microsoft Windows and Excel
  • Experience or desire to learn Microsoft SQL Server and Reporting Services
  • Nice to have experience with programming and development of Windows Applications
  • Nice to have experience with Microsoft Power BI
  • Nice to have experience with basic Microsoft Windows Server administration
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn
  • Advanced English skills

 

We Offer

  • Compensation in accordance with experience
  • Performance bonuses
  • Learning and development opportunities
  • Relaxed office atmosphere
  • Flexible benefits
